title: Hope S NDE 3026
content: I saw myself in bed; I was at the ceiling and I thought that was fun, I loved the bird's eye view. I could see my mother beside me, with a sponge and ice water and I could hear her praying even though she was not speaking aloud. I could then see everything going on outside too. I was bored with the scene and just then a person spoke to me and I was embraced with great love. There were several of these people there with me and they told me I had found my way to a different place of life. They spoke to me just like you would speak to a child, they told me that I was very sick and to get better I would have to go with them. I was happy to do so. I then saw myself above my house and going higher and higher until I could see the planet from space. I traveled across space and I was told that I was being taken to the home planet of these people so I could get better. When we got there, I made a comment about how much everything looked like the place I had just come from. They laughed and told me that in order for me to feel comfortable, and get better, that they had made everything to look like home. They put me in bed, told me to sleep, and that I would wake up in three days. On day three, I awoke already home and in the hospital. After that, I could leave my body any time and loved to do because I could talk to the other people by doing so.

arrival.other_being_detail: Described as 'several of these people' who said they were taking her to their 'home planet' so she could get better; they made the place look like her home for comfort.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'home planet' made to look like her home; she was put in a bed there.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She was told she would 'wake up in three days' and on day three she awoke 'already home and in the hospital.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Traveling upward above the house, seeing Earth from space, traveling across space to a 'home planet' where beings put her to bed and told her she'd wake in three days.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with expanded perception (including outside), encounter/communication with beings, travel through space (no tunnel described), arrival in a constructed home-like environment, then awakening back in hospital after 'three days.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Beings described as from a 'home planet' who altered the environment to look like her home for comfort and healing; told she would sleep and wake in three days; afterwards she reports being able to leave her body any time to talk to them.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could hear her praying even though she was not speaking aloud.” “they had made everything to look like home.” “After that, I could leave my body any time and loved to do because I could talk to the other people by doing so.”
